note: Bounded pilot inventory. Every module named here is encoder-generated and carries an apply manifest under .axiom/encoding-manifests/. A listed instrument is NOT fully encoded; encoded_sections names exactly what this repository covers as a module on disk, and applied_without_a_module names provisions a shipped number depends on that have NO module — both directions are enforced by repository tests. No Israel corpus release exists, so no release is bound and .axiom/toolchain.toml is absent.

§40(א) נקודות קיצבה and §40(ב) single-parent credit points

applied_without_a_module.why: The composition has to say which §121ב(ה) category an employment wage falls in. §2(2) `השתכרות או ריווח מעבודה` is quoted as a definition atom; §2 itself is not encoded as a module.

not_encoded: §65 as a module — its age-and-presence proviso is applied in the composition, see applied_without_a_module; its maintained-child limb and §65(ב)'s three-month rule are not modelled at all
national insurance and health contributions (§335 and Health Insurance Law §14)

applied_without_a_module.why: §65(א)'s `ובלבד שהילד נמצא בישראל ולא מלאו לו 18 שנים` decides the monthly allowance count. The test has to be asked once per child and this pilot declares no Child entity, so §65 has no single-answer shape an atomic module could take. It IS in the corpus and IS encodable. See docs/ENCODING-GAPS.md, nii-section-65-child-definition-partial.

corpus_expression_note: The Israel corpus ingest holds ONE expression of each provision, dated by the consolidation's own נוסח עדכני line. This repository therefore encodes the current text and cannot compute a 2025 liability; ITO §121's bands are the post-amendment-288 text.
policy_publications_note: Empty deliberately. Every module in this repository is encoder-generated from a corpus citation, and no il/policy scope has been ingested, so no current-year regulated amount is encoded here. The composed pipeline takes those as supplied inputs and its fixtures state where each number came from.
